summary: fix(auth): use constant-time comparison for password verify-hash check
description:
Compares verify hashes with a constant-time check so timing does not leak
how many leading characters matched, and rejects non-hex or odd-length
input before decoding so truncation cannot make two different strings
compare equal.

(cherry picked from commit 0f44fb65be4fec32002047d3727da8e36d1b6e27)
